description: This Python source file implements a class for configuring, constructing URLs, validating environment variables, transforming request parameters, and parsing responses for a Deepinfra rerank model, designed to interface with a reranking API similar in spec to Cohere's. It contains class definitions, methods for request/response handling, and environment validation.

classes.name: DeepinfraRerankConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for DeepInfra rerank, extending BaseRerankConfig, providing methods to build endpoint URLs, validate environment variables, map rerank parameters, transform requests/responses, and handle errors.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and prepares headers with API key and other required info for making API calls.

methods.name: Dict map_cohere_rerank_params( self, non_default_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, query: str, documents: List[Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, top_n: Optional[int] = None, rank_fields: Optional[List[str]] = None, return_documents: Optional[bool] = True, max_chunks_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Maps input parameters into the format expected by DeepInfra rerank API, aligning with Cohere's format.

methods.name: dict transform_rerank_request( self, model: str, optional_rerank_params: Dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms parameter objects into dictionary form suitable for requests.

methods.name: RerankResponse transform_rerank_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: RerankResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str] = None, request_data: dict = {}, optional_params: dict = {}, litellm_params: dict = {}, )

methods.description: Returns a list of supported rerank parameters for the Cohere-like interface.
